fields.description: The doctype people may read their own records of. A doctype with no enabled record here is not self-service, whatever anyone's permissions say.
fields.label: Document Type

fields.description: Turn off to withdraw this record type from self service without deleting how it was configured.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Field to read as the record's name in a list or a queue. Defaults to the record's id.
fields.label: Title Field

fields.description: One record per owner, so a page can ask for "mine" without naming it -- an employee record. Leave clear where an owner may have several, such as bank accounts, and the page lists them.
fields.label: One Per Owner

fields.description: Field on this doctype that says whose record it is. A Link to User names the owner outright; anything else names a record of Owner Document Type, and ownership follows that.
fields.label: Owner Field

fields.description: Set when Owner Field points at another self-service record rather than at a User -- a bank account names its Employee. Leave blank when the field names a User.
fields.label: Owner Document Type

fields.description: Extra conditions a record must meet before it counts as somebody's, as JSON -- {"status": "Active"} stops a leaver's record being theirs to read. Leave blank for none.
fields.label: Record Filters

fields.description: What the page shows and what may be proposed. Order here is the order on the page.
fields.label: Fields

fields.description: What the sidebar row and the page heading say -- "My profile", "Bank accounts".
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The page's address under /profile. Lowercase, letters, digits and hyphens.
fields.label: Route Slug

fields.description: A lucide icon class for the sidebar row, such as lucide-id-card. One of the set in commons/self_service/icons.py -- anything else has no CSS and would draw blank, so it is refused. Blank falls back to a generic mark.
fields.label: Icon

fields.description: Sidebar order, low to high. Ties break on label.
fields.label: Order

fields.description: Shown above the record. Say who holds these details and how a correction is actually made. Blank uses a generic line.
fields.label: Read-only Notice

fields.description: Shown when this user owns no such record. Say who to ask. Blank uses a generic line.
fields.label: Nothing-to-show Notice

fields.description: Let an owner propose a whole new record of this type. Nothing is created until the request is approved. Only for record types where an owner may have several, and only where some fields are proposable -- those are the fields a new record can set.
fields.label: Owners May Propose New Records

fields.description: Let an owner ask for one of their records to be removed. Nothing is deleted until the request is approved, and the deletion still fails if anything else links to the record.
fields.label: Owners May Propose Deletions
